title: Blinding Lights
hook: Why do these chords feel like *a night drive alone*?
question: Got it within 3 chords? Be honest 👇

chords.name: Fm
chords.text: Home: *F minor*. Dark streets, neon glow.

chords.name: Eb
chords.text: *E♭ major* starts to climb. The road opens.

chords.name: Bb
chords.text: *B♭ major* brings D natural: sudden headlights.

chords.name: Fm
chords.text: Back to F minor. *Still alone, still racing*.
